# HelpOne

> HelpOne (HelpOne Software, Inc., Somers, NY) is all-in-one nonprofit software: one login for volunteer management, event management, fundraising, donors & contacts (CRM), finances (auto Form 990 & NY CHAR500), HR, policies & procedures, training tracking, participant breakdown and board management. Unlimited users and records on a flat monthly price, with no per-seat or per-record fees.

Key facts (from this website):

- Built exclusively for nonprofits; the platform is live and in a Founders / early-access phase.
- Pricing: Founders Program $499/month, locked for the first 12 months, plus a permanent 20% lifetime discount. Growth plan $599/month after the Founders period. Scale plan (full white-label, dedicated support, custom development) by custom quote. All plans include all modules and unlimited records, events, transactions, forms and reports. No setup fees, no contracts, cancel anytime.
- NYCON members: $399/month for the first year, then $449/month.
- Payments: flat rate $1.75/transaction + $15/month when you bring your own processor, or interchange-plus (IC+) when HelpOne handles processing. A HelpOne subscription is not required to use HelpOne Payments.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II certified; card payments run through a PCI DSS Level 1 processor partner; AES-256 encryption; GDPR-aligned data practices.
- Onboarding: free data migration and setup help; most organizations are up and running within 2–4 weeks.
- Founder & CEO: Edward Zaremba. Strategic technology partner: Citinet Solutions.
- Memberships: New York Council of Nonprofits (NYCON), Nonprofit New York, Nonprofit Westchester, Business Council of Westchester.
- Contact: hello@helponesoftware.com (general), sales@helponesoftware.com (demos & sales), support@helponesoftware.com (support).

## Platform modules

- [Volunteer Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/volunteer-management): Self-service portal, QR check-ins, skill matching, shifts, background checks, and hours tracking that feeds Form 990.
- [Event Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/event-management): Unified event hub, dynamic ticketing, multi-day schedules and volunteer sync.
- [Fundraising](https://www.helponesoftware.com/fundraising): Auctions, pledges, donations, contests and sponsorships with real-time P&L and automatic volunteer-hour valuation for Form 990.
- [Donors & Contacts](https://www.helponesoftware.com/donors-and-contacts): Donor CRM with rich profiles, giving history, smart folders and custom blasts.
- [Finances](https://www.helponesoftware.com/finances): Nonprofit chart of accounts, real-time P&L, restricted funds, auto Form 990 and CHAR500.
- [HR Solutions](https://www.helponesoftware.com/hr-solutions): Nonprofit HR: onboarding, reviews and time off.
- [Policies & Procedures](https://www.helponesoftware.com/policies-and-procedures): Living policy books, approvals and instant PDF export.
- [Training Tracking](https://www.helponesoftware.com/training-tracking): Training assignments, reminders and progress dashboards.
- [Participants](https://www.helponesoftware.com/participants): Participant breakdown with engagement scoring, real-time segmentation and activity breakdowns.
- [Board Management](https://www.helponesoftware.com/board-management): Board members, committees, meetings, documents, votes, conflict-of-interest compliance, tasks and a board member portal.
- [My HelpOne](https://www.helponesoftware.com/my-helpone): Personal dashboard for staff: action items, events, calendar, timesheets and time-off requests.
- [Payments](https://www.helponesoftware.com/payments): Flat-rate or IC+ payment processing with text-to-give, QR codes, hosted pages and embeddable forms.
- [Switching to HelpOne Payments](https://www.helponesoftware.com/switching-to-helpone-payments): How to move payment processing to HelpOne.
